description: Fiches signalétiques du réseau de Nivellement Général de la Polynésie-française (NGPF) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Section Cadastre-Topographie de la Polynésie française. Data sheets of the French Polynesia General Level Network (NGPF) covering the Corporation’s islands in PDF format. Coverage: Section Cadastre-Topographie de la Polynésie française. The portal shows the English title as "Material Safety Data Sheets for the French Polynesia General Leveling Network (NGPF)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Section Cadastre-Topographie de la Polynésie française. Its keywords include polynesie-francaise, description-du-reseau, ngpf, nivellement, topographie. The listing shows 6 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2022-03-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
